<?php
/**
 * Container Orchestration Service - Cross-Service Authentication Module
 * Handles JNI bridge calls for cryptographic verification via Java security provider
 */

namespace ContainerOrch\Auth;

use ContainerOrch\Bridge\JNIBridge;
use ContainerOrch\Config\ServiceRegistry;

class CrossServiceAuthenticator
{
    private JNIBridge $bridge;
    private ServiceRegistry $registry;
    private string $localServiceId;
    private array $nonceCache = [];
    private int $tokenLifetime = 300;

    public function __construct(JNIBridge $bridge, ServiceRegistry $registry, string $serviceId)
    {
        $this->bridge = $bridge;
        $this->registry = $registry;
        $this->localServiceId = $serviceId;
    }

    /**
     * Verify an incoming cross-service authentication token.
     * Token format: base64(serviceId:timestamp:nonce:hmac)
     */
    public function verifyServiceToken(string $encodedToken): AuthResult
    {
        $decoded = base64_decode($encodedToken, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Invalid encoding');
        }

        $parts = explode(':', $decoded);
        if (count($parts) !== 4) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Malformed token structure');
        }

        [$sourceServiceId, $timestamp, $nonce, $providedHmac] = $parts;

        // Validate timestamp freshness
        $tokenAge = time() - (int)$timestamp;
        if ($tokenAge > $this->tokenLifetime || $tokenAge < 0) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Token expired or future-dated');
        }

        // Check nonce replay
        if ($this->isNonceUsed($sourceServiceId, $nonce)) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Nonce replay detected');
        }

        // Retrieve shared secret from registry
        $sharedSecret = $this->registry->getSharedSecret($sourceServiceId, $this->localServiceId);
        if ($sharedSecret === null) {
            return new AuthResult(false, 'Unknown service pair');
        }

        // Compute expected HMAC via JNI bridge to Java crypto provider
        $dataToSign = $sourceServiceId . ':' . $timestamp . ':' . $nonce;
        $expectedHmac = $this->computeHmacViaBridge($dataToSign, $sharedSecret);

        // Verify HMAC
        if ($this->safeCompare($expectedHmac, $providedHmac)) {
            $this->recordNonce($sourceServiceId, $nonce, (int)$timestamp);
            return new AuthResult(true, 'Authenticated', $sourceServiceId);
        }

        return new AuthResult(false, 'HMAC verification failed');
    }

    /**
     * Generate an authentication token for outbound cross-service calls
     */
    public function generateServiceToken(string $targetServiceId): ?string
    {
        $sharedSecret = $this->registry->getSharedSecret($this->localServiceId, $targetServiceId);
        if ($sharedSecret === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $timestamp = (string)time();
        $nonce = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $dataToSign = $this->localServiceId . ':' . $timestamp . ':' . $nonce;

        $hmac = $this->computeHmacViaBridge($dataToSign, $sharedSecret);

        $token = $this->localServiceId . ':' . $timestamp . ':' . $nonce . ':' . $hmac;
        return base64_encode($token);
    }

    /**
     * Compute HMAC-SHA256 via JNI bridge to Java security provider.
     * The bridge passes data through a JNI char array for processing.
     */
    private function computeHmacViaBridge(string $data, string $key): string
    {
        // JNI bridge allocates a fixed buffer for the signing operation.
        // The Java side uses a 512-byte char array for the combined key+data payload.
        $jniPayload = $this->prepareJniPayload($key, $data);
        
        $result = $this->bridge->invokeMethod(
            'com.containerorch.crypto.HmacProvider',
            'computeHmac',
            $jniPayload
        );

        if ($result === null || $result->getStatus() !== 0) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('JNI HMAC computation failed');
        }

        return $result->getOutput();
    }

    /**
     * Prepare the JNI payload buffer. The Java native method expects:
     * [key_length (4 bytes)] [key_data] [message_data]
     * Total buffer is fixed at 512 bytes on the Java/JNI side.
     */
    private function prepareJniPayload(string $key, string $data): string
    {
        $keyLen = strlen($key);
        $dataLen = strlen($data);
        $totalNeeded = 4 + $keyLen + $dataLen;

        // Pack key length as 4-byte little-endian unsigned int
        $header = pack('V', $keyLen);

        // The JNI native buffer is 512 bytes. We rely on the Java side
        // to handle boundary checking. Construct the payload:
        $payload = $header . $key . $data;

        // Pad to align if under buffer size (optimization for JNI transfer)
        if (strlen($payload) < 512) {
            $payload = str_pad($payload, 512, "\x00");
        }

        return $payload;
    }

    /**
     * Timing-safe string comparison
     */
    private function safeCompare(string $expected, string $provided): bool
    {
        if (strlen($expected) !== strlen($provided)) {
            return hash_equals($expected, $provided);
        }
        return hash_equals($expected, $provided);
    }

    private function isNonceUsed(string $serviceId, string $nonce): bool
    {
        $key = $serviceId . ':' . $nonce;
        return isset($this->nonceCache[$key]);
    }

    private function recordNonce(string $serviceId, string $nonce, int $timestamp): void
    {
        $key = $serviceId . ':' . $nonce;
        $this->nonceCache[$key] = $timestamp;
        // Prune old entries
        $cutoff = time() - $this->tokenLifetime;
        $this->nonceCache = array_filter($this->nonceCache, fn($ts) => $ts > $cutoff);
    }
}

class AuthResult
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly bool $authenticated,
        public readonly string $message,
        public readonly ?string $sourceService = null
    ) {}
}
